solution_steps: Normal summon Tsukuyomi. Use its effect to flip Magician of Faith face-down.
Flip Magician of Faith face-up again and reclaim Swords of Revealing Light from your graveyard.
Activate the Swords to flip your opponents face-downs.
Then use Lightning Vortex by discarding any card from your hand, and attack for game.
